comparison: Perfect agreement on claims C13, C40, C88-C95, C117 regarding transient phenotype and recovery at P60. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED and acknowledge the mosaic Cre expression as a contributing factor while accepting the core finding of phenotypic normalization.

Perfect agreement on claims C98-C100 regarding absence of changes in adipocyte and GI hormones. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED and accept these findings as part of the comprehensive metabolic hormone panel supporting a direct liver-pancreas axis.

Strong agreement on claims C3-C5, C82-C87 regarding absence of motor neuron pathology. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED and treat this as a key strength enabling study of liver-specific effects without confounding motor pathology. Peer review also includes C110.

Strong agreement on claims C50-C55 regarding tissue-specific SMN depletion. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED and acknowledge mosaic Cre expression as a limitation that does not undermine the core finding. Peer review also includes C37 regarding 30% residual SMN.

Strong agreement on claims C41-C43, C103-C105, C107-C109 regarding survival and absence of SMA phenotype. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED and treat model viability as a major advantage for studying long-term liver-specific effects. Peer review also includes C114.

Strong agreement on claims C8-C12, C67-C71 regarding pancreatic dysfunction. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED with statistical significance demonstrated. Peer review additionally includes C75-C77 and notes mechanistic link requires further investigation.

Divergent evaluations on claims C6, C58-C62 regarding liver steatosis. OpenEval rates as UNCERTAIN due to lack of statistical significance in triglyceride quantification and high variability. Peer review rates as SUPPORTED, accepting histological evidence and acknowledging mild phenotype. Peer review also includes C115-C116.

Agreement on claims C73-C74, C78 regarding normal insulin and C-peptide levels. Both evaluations rate as SUPPORTED. OpenEval also includes C77 and emphasizes the surprising nature of this finding given reduced β-cell numbers.

Agreement on claims C7, C64-C65 regarding liver function markers. Both evaluations rate as UNCERTAIN and acknowledge mosaic Cre expression complicates interpretation. OpenEval also includes C126 regarding trends in transferrin and HO levels. Peer review also includes C127.

Both address liver-to-pancreas signaling mechanism (C79, C96, C101-C102, C139). OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED based on pancreatic dysfunction despite normal pancreatic SMN. Peer review rates as SUPPORTED after revision clarified mechanistic link, also includes C14-C15, C44, C155-C156 regarding broader interpretation of liver-pancreas axis.

Agreement on claims C140, C144, C149-C150 regarding speculative amino acid metabolism hypothesis. Both evaluations rate as UNCERTAIN and acknowledge this is explicitly presented as speculation by authors for future investigation. OpenEval includes additional speculative claims C141-C143, C145-C148.

Partial overlap on claims C14-C15, C44 regarding experimental limitations. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED, noting authors appropriately qualify interpretations given mosaic Cre expression. Peer review includes these claims within broader SUPPORTED evaluation of liver-pancreas axis interpretation.

Partial overlap on claim C37 regarding SMN depletion levels. OpenEval rates C37, C115-C116 as SUPPORTED based on immunoblot and histological data. Peer review includes C37 within broader SUPPORTED evaluation of tissue-specific depletion (C50-C55).

Partial overlap on claims C115-C116 regarding SMN's role in lipid metabolism. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED with reasonable inference from observed phenotype. Peer review includes these claims within SUPPORTED evaluation of liver steatosis findings.

Partial overlap on claims C155-C156 regarding liver/pancreatic abnormalities occurring independently of motor neuron disease. OpenEval rates as SUPPORTED based on absence of motor pathology. Peer review includes these claims within broader SUPPORTED evaluation of liver-pancreas axis.

OpenEval evaluates claims C118-C124 regarding prior work citations as SUPPORTED, noting convergence of clinical, in vitro, and in vivo evidence. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these literature context claims.

Peer review evaluates claims C134-C135 regarding model utility as SUPPORTED, noting superiority of non-lethal liver-specific depletion for long-term studies. No corresponding OpenEval result found for these model utility claims.
